asset_ownership_interpretation: The reviewed first-party FAQ establishes a fixed-period crypto lending contract but does not provide sufficient dedicated authority to characterize lent balances as segregated, insured, trust-protected or otherwise insulated from operator counterparty exposure. Ordinary exchange custody treatment is not generalized to the lending product.
notes: Published annual rates remain issuer terms rather than verified realized returns. Customer-requested mid-term cancellation is unavailable. Lending-specific insolvency treatment and principal-protection status remain unresolved without stronger dedicated first-party terms.
